description: This file defines the Sections class, which represents a collection of document sections within the MigraDoc document object model. It provides methods for adding sections, accessing sections by index, cloning, and serialization, and implements the visitor pattern.

classes.name: Sections
classes.description: Represents a collection of document sections, providing methods for managing and serializing the collection.

classes.name: Sections.SectionsValues
classes.description: Contains internal nullable property values for the Sections object.

methods.name: Sections
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the collection with default values.

methods.name: Sections(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing with a parent document object.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Gets a section at the specified index, cast to the Section type.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Sections collection.

methods.name: AddSection
methods.description: Creates and adds a new Section to the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the collection of sections into DDL format.
